changelog:
Initial public release of ClawCache Free v0.2.0

Features:
- Cost tracking with automatic logging and daily CLI reports
- Smart caching with 58.3% hit rate proven
- Multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Ollama)
- Zero dependencies, async support, cross-platform
- Security-first with opt-in pickle deserialization

Built for the OpenClaw community. 100% local & private.
display_name: ClawCache Free - LLM Cost Tracking & Caching
summary: Track and log LLM API costs with automatic token counting and cache exact responses locally using SQLite to reduce expenses and boost efficiency.
